argv:
set -u
printf 'SECTION ltp-small-install\n'
root=/var/tmp/afs-e2e-20261006-r1/suites/ltp-small-install
for f in "$root/kirk" "$root/runtest/fs" "$root/runtest/fs_bind" "$root/runtest/fs_perms_simple" "$root/runtest/fcntl-locktests"; do
  printf 'PATH %s\n' "$f"
  if test -e "$f"; then ls -l "$f"; test -f "$f" && sha256sum "$f"; else echo MISSING; fi
done
find "$root" -path '*/testcases/bin/*' -type f \( -name open01 -o -name read01 -o -name write01 -o -name stat01 -o -name chmod01 -o -name fcntl14 \) -print -exec ls -l {} \; -exec sha256sum {} \; 2>/dev/null | sort
printf 'SECTION ltp-expanded-tsv\n'
for f in /var/tmp/afs-e2e-20261006-r1/suites/ltp-filesystem-expanded.tsv; do
  printf 'PATH %s\n' "$f"
  if test -e "$f"; then ls -l "$f"; sha256sum "$f"; head -10 "$f"; else echo MISSING; fi
done
